Short answer: Postgres rejected the connection because there’s no pg_hba.conf rule that permits client IP 10.2.4.19 for the svc user/database. The env dump in the log included a plaintext DB password (do not paste that); rotate that credential immediately because it’s been exposed.

Before I give the one-liner for the team: do you want a sanitized message (no secret value included)? Reply "yes" and I’ll produce it.
